scripts.build:android: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path android/app/src/main/assets) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force android/app/src/main/assets } ; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path android/app/src/main/assets ; Copy-Item -Path dist/* -Destination android/app/src/main/assets -Recurse -Force"
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run build:android && powershell -Command "cd android ; .\gradlew assembleDebug"
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run build:android && powershell -Command "cd android ; .\gradlew assembleRelease"
